outcome: Arterial umbilical cord pH below seven
cohort: Women in Finland with singleton preterm breech births from 2000 to 2017 (n = 1259)
finding: Women with a previous preterm caesarean breech delivery had an increased risk of uterine rupture and their neonates had an increased risk of arterial umbilical cord pH below seven and neonatal intensive care unit admission in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with a previous preterm caesarean section were more likely to have a planned caesarean section, an emergency caesarean section, or an instrumental vaginal delivery in their subsequent pregnancy.
